profile.name: SLCAN CAN总线接口
profile.description: 用于通过兼容 SLCAN 协议的串口/CAN 适配器与 CAN 总线设备通信。可在实验系统中完成总线连接打开与关闭、位速率配置、报文发送，以及读取接口版本和序列号等操作，适合连接和调试各类基于 CAN 的实验装置。
profile.description_en: A CAN bus interface for communicating with CAN devices through an adapter compatible with the SLCAN protocol. In laboratory setups, it is used to open and close the bus connection, configure bitrate, send frames, and read interface version and serial number for connecting and debugging CAN-based experimental equipment.
